title: Speakers
body:
THIS OLD FORM IS FOR THE 2012 EVENT, WHICH ALREADY OCCURED. DO NOT SUBMIT HERE!  

IF YOU ARE LOOKING FOR THE UPCOMING EVENT CLICK HERE.

Please fill out the form below to submit a request to be a speaker. Once we receive your information, someone from OpenStack will contact you about the potential speaking opportunity.

The deadline for speaker submissions is February 17, 2012 February 29, 2012.
